invariants.rationale: The method returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object as it is returned from an execute() call.
The getWriteStatuses() should return a non-null List as part of the result contract.
A List's size is always non-negative; important for integrity of returned metadata.
Input records list should be non-null as per contract as it is passed directly to the executor.
instantTime typically represents a commit instant and should be non-null and non-empty.
